Data retention & privacy

What we store about listings

Normalized fields, the original source URL, timestamps of each re-check, and a raw payload snapshot for auditing. Personal contact details of sellers/agents are not collected or displayed.

Retention

Active listings remain while the source keeps them available. Listings missing from three consecutive syncs are marked unavailable and archived after 90 days. Raw snapshots are purged after 18 months. Price observations are kept long-term for trend honesty.

User accounts

We store your email, name (optional), a bcrypt password hash, session records and saved searches. Delete your account any time via the account page request email; deletion is completed within 30 days including sessions and saved data.

Cookies & analytics

Only a functional session cookie when you sign in. No third-party advertising cookies are set unless you configure an ads provider (see README).

Takedowns & corrections

Contact legal@your-domain to request removal under applicable law or source agreements. We action verified requests within 7 days and log the change.

Data aggregated from public/authorized sources for Indore only. Listings link to their original source pages.Collection policy & transparency
